comparison.objective: Insert a battery correctly and screw on a flashlight cap; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Polarity-aware insertion, thread starting, repeated regrasping, and cap tightening versus setscrew unlocking, collar tuning, and witness-tested relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Correctly oriented cell and cap seated after sufficient thread rotation versus safe repeated impacts within stroke and response limits.
comparison.reason: Threaded assembly and damper calibration are not duplicates despite shared rotation and regrasping; all nine versions provide adequate rubric detail.
